nodes.text: Let $G$ be a graph such that $R(G,T_n)\ll n$ for any tree $T_n$ on $n$ vertices and $R(G,K_n)\ll n^2$. Is it true that, for any $H$ with $m$ edges and no isolated vertices,\[R(G,H)\ll m?\]

#568 : [EFRS93] graph theory | ramsey theory In other words, is $G$ Ramsey size linear? This problem is #33 in Ramsey Theory in the graphs problem collection.
